h1: Méribel ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Méribel sits in the middle of the three valleys, which is its whole argument: both neighbouring valleys are reachable without doubling back. Its five villages run from Les Allues at 1,100 metres up to Mottaret at 1,750, and the pass opens 600 kilometres of slopes across 337 runs. The season runs 5 December to 18 April.
stayOverview: Les Allues is the old village down the valley, Méribel Centre is the heart of the resort at 1,450 metres, and Mottaret at 1,750 puts you highest and closest to the lifts into the other valleys.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Mottaret is the ski-in choice; Les Allues is the village with a life of its own.
rentalCars: Méribel is reached up the Tarentaise from Moûtiers, about two hours from Geneva.
